rules: All scenarios use only repo artifacts, verifier JSON, manifest SHA, Context OS, MCP memory — NO conversation memory
Watcher and controller do NOT mutate state or mark PASS
Startup verification is mandatory before any continuation
Clean scenario does NOT mean automatic phase closure
